tests.L3 VIX term-structure panic bounce (PRIM: VIX close / VIX3M close > 1.0 on day d (backwardation) -> long US500 and US100 CFDs (0.5 each) from 14:00 UTC on day d+1 for 3 trading days (exit 14:00 UTC on the 3rd trading day after entry); re-signals extend the hold
